page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a running head at the top and page number at the top right. Verse lines in italic, with a centred small-capitals heading "IN EANDEM." mid-page, followed by a drop-capital verse stanza.

p.i: Ego vos amaui? brachiis Foui, refouíque, & fatigaui meis Viscata labra basiys?
Plebi lupanar prostitutum sordida Vocare amores pertuli?
O fraus, amórque, & mentis emota furor, Et impotentes impetus Quò me abstulistis? vindices Erinnyes Quo vapulasti crimine
Vestrum ad tribunal? non enim Cupidinis Dolui sagitta saucium:
Sed vestra aduftus, vestra aduftu lampade, Furore vestro insanij.
Ergo pudendis liberatus vinculis, Mei que iuris reddítus, , Sanctí Saluti fospitatrici mea Et has catellas ferreas, Monumenta duri seruitij, & tabellulam Hanc Sanitatis indicem
Per eam recepte, & memoris animi pignora Dono, libénsque dedico.
VIndemiales feria claudunt Scholas, Iuuenes penates patrios Repetunt: per vrbem solitudo: in edibus Mœstum silentium: fores Rarus cucullus obsidet tuas: sonat Stridore raro ianua.
Quid ages misella? sauientis inguinis Pruriginem quis leniet? Fruftra angiportus, viculos, forum grauis

page.notes: Drop capital V of the stanza "VIndemiales" read as V. Some marks on the scan (small blots, a faint mark near "reddítus") are not printed text. Line-end "mea", "tuas" and "lampade" read with some doubt; the "[?]" marker was not needed as the letters are legible on the scan.
